_doc: Real-print lyric OCR gold, hand-transcribed from the local page corpus (image paths under gitignored data/, so scoring requires the local corpus). Rows are the syllabic 'Κυριε ελεησον' Greek lyric lines printed under each neume block on Mass/page_0498, each opening with an ornamental drop-cap Kappa. This Greek-Arabic Mass book carries Arabic only as page furniture (headers), not as lyric rows, so real Arabic-lyric accuracy stays on the synthetic benchmark until an Arabic-lyric source is added. Score: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH uv run python tools/audit_lyric_ocr.py score --gold config/expected_lyrics_real.json --output data/lyric_ocr_report_real.json
